page.layout: One printed title page, one block of centred lines. Small line at the top, large capitals title, smaller lines below in the centre, a short block of lines further down, and a date line at the foot. No margins with text.
page.notes: The scan is very faded. The large capitals of the title and all the smaller lines are too faint to read, so no words are given. The line count and letter counts are estimates. The line at the foot, which looks like cIↄ Iↄ with further strokes, may be show-through from the reverse side and is not transcribed. The dark blot and the grey oval in the centre are stains, not print.
